title: Asia Cup 2025
desc: Hardik Pandya struck with the second ball to remove Saim Ayub for a golden duck, and India’s spinners soon had Pakistan crumbling at 64/6. Shaheen Afridi’s late surge lifted the total to 127. In response, Abhishek Sharma’s fiery 31 off 13 set the tone, while captain Suryakumar Yadav anchored the chase with a steady 47 off 37, sealing a comfortable 7-wicket win for India.
